entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Scholar from Penregon, pupil of Tocasia, who knew Urza and Mishra as children and married Feldon.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother known to Loran in childhood.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother known to Loran in childhood.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Captured Loran and took the Sylex.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Later received the Sylex from Ashnod.

entities.name: Yumok
entities.description: People who delivered the Sylex and fled with Loran.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Blast ending the war in 64 AR.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Site where Loran and Feldon stood at the blast.

events.summary: Loran travels from Penregon to Terisia City and meets the scholars at the Ivory Tower.
events.quote: She arrived at the Ivory Tower and there met Feldon

events.summary: The Yumok deliver the Sylex to Feldon; Feldon and Loran feel darkness on touching it.
events.quote: they felt a darkness come over them as if the sun had fallen behind an eclipse

events.summary: During the Fall of Terisia City, Loran escapes with the Sylex but is caught in an avalanche triggered by Ashnod, who captures her.
events.quote: The avalanche had been triggered by Ashnod, who discovered the Sylex and took both it and Loran into captivity.

events.summary: Feldon rescues Loran after several years.
events.quote: After several years, Feldon found and rescued Loran

events.summary: Loran and Feldon are at the Ronom Glacier for the Sylex Blast and she says 'Good.'
events.quote: Realizing the war was over, Loran simply said "Good."

events.summary: Urza visits Loran disguised as a grieving widow.
events.quote: Urza appeared to Loran in the guise of a grieving widow.

events.summary: Loran dies in bed ten years after the blast.
events.quote: Loran died ten years after the Sylex Blast

events.summary: Feldon temporarily resurrects Loran with white mana.
events.quote: He did so with white mana, but only long enough for him to say goodbye.

relations.quote: Ashnod forced Loran to share the secrets of the Terisian scholars
